provenance: Recorded LMU session, source lap_number 12. Game scoring mLapDist and mPathLateral in metres. First telemetry frame of each 5 Hz scoring timestamp. Native world mPos.x/z, unfiltered brake, throttle, steering and speed from local velocity. Lap start epochs establish the duration. No interpolated start/finish samples. The recorded count flag cannot establish track-limit validity.
